reason: A security utility for DeepSeek Harness that statically scans plugins and uses runtime gates to monitor or block selected steps, tools, file operations, and installations.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供插件静态扫描、运行时操作拦截、安装后检查以及 Web 面板和白名单管理。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with plugin static scanning, runtime operation interception, post-install checks, and web-panel and allowlist management.

capabilities: Statically scans source files and reports rule-based findings
Intercepts and can block selected agent steps, tool calls, file operations, and shell commands
Monitors sensitive-path access and session token usage
Watches newly installed plugins and records scan events
Provides a web panel and persistent user-managed allowlist
